pages.text: The host controls these settings per world in $(thing)serverconfig/biginventory-server.toml$(), under the $(thing)[storage]$() section. In singleplayer, serverconfig is inside the save folder.

pages.title: Capacity and Weight
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)baseCapacity$() starts at 500 and accepts nonnegative integers.$(li)$(thing)footprintFactor$() starts at 32 and accepts integers from 1 to 8192. It changes how expensive small stacks are.$(p)Explore the $(l:https://www.desmos.com/calculator/py8ad6ng5t)weight curve$(/l).

pages.title: Refill
pages.text: $(thing)refillHotbar$() defaults to true. Set it to false to disable automatic stack and tool refills. Use $(l:biginventory:server/curios_settings)curioCapacity$(/l) to add rules for equipped accessories.
